headline: Shore-power grants open for harbours under 200 berths
standfirst: Boats running generators alongside are the largest single source of harbour-side emissions in most small ports.

image.alt: Power bollards on a harbour wall

body.text: The scheme covers up to 70 per cent of installation costs for shore-power points, with applications open until the end of October. Priority goes to harbours where the local grid connection already has capacity, which in practice means a lot of the west coast will not qualify.
Ports that miss out on this round are being pointed towards a battery-buffer pilot, which is smaller, slower and not yet funded beyond a feasibility stage.
